about: Which AlloFlow tools need generative AI. One record per tool. "class" is set by a person; callSites, readAloud, micCloud and network are recomputed by `node dev-tools/check_ai_requirements.cjs --write`. Checked by `--check` and tests/ai_requirements_inventory.test.js.

classes.none: no generative-AI call site in the tool file (read-aloud is tracked separately)
classes.optional: the core activity works with no AI; aiAdds says what AI adds, partial says what inside the tool does need it

fields.readAloud: the file calls callTTS. Read-aloud uses a Gemini voice when Gemini is connected, otherwise the device voice.
fields.network: hosts the tool file (or a companion page it opens from the app CDN) requests, found by URL scan; links and citations are left out
fields.micCloud: the file uses the browser SpeechRecognition API (speech may be processed by the browser vendor)
fields.deepLink: the id for /app/?tool=<id> when the generated deep-link map has it, else null
fields.gate: "manual" = the file-level count cannot express the class (shared file, or AI reaches the tool through a host callback); the checker lists these instead of counting them
fields.guardRead: true = the no-AI guard at each call site was read, not just counted
